## New in this release

### New
- **Version number** at the bottom of the menu (e.g. "Version 0.4.5 (21) · beta").
- **Update check:** when the app starts and a newer release is out, a popup shows the link to the latest release on GitHub. The only thing sent is a request to GitHub for the newest version number; offline, the check is skipped silently. You'll first see it once the release after this one is out.

### Behind the scenes
- Automatic checks after each change now only run the tests; the app is built once per release. This halves the build minutes per release.
- Each release now also checks that the self-hosting Docker image still builds.
- Release notes now list every change since the previous release. The notes of 0.4.2, 0.4.3 and 0.4.4 were filled in too.

### Known issues
- Parent accounts that log in through **ID Austria** don't work yet.
